runtime.browser: Claude in-app Browser for interaction; Google Chrome headless for retained screenshots
runtime.browser_version: in-app Browser plugin 26.828.0 (embedded Chromium build not exposed); Chrome headless 141

fixture: F-UI synthetic publication fixture built by tools/build_public_demo_estate.py. The imperfect-estate journey uses a purpose-built temporary estate, and the independent-launch journey uses the clean-install artefact produced the same day.
limitations: The in-app browser pane does not composite frames. It therefore delivers neither media-query change nor resize events from its own viewport emulation, and CSS transitions never advance. Viewport-dependent behaviour was measured by setting the viewport and reading computed layout, and the breakpoint reconciliation was exercised by dispatching the event the pane does not deliver. This is a limitation of the observing tool, recorded rather than worked around silently.
